extracted.name: Appalachian Mud Pie
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, mix together dry ingredients.
In another bowl, mix wet ingredients.
Add wet ingredients to dry and stir together.
Spread batter in a buttered 9 inch spring pan
Bake at 350 for 25 minutes (until toothpick comes clean).
Sift cocoa powder & powder sugar & add remaining ingredients for frosting. Mix until combined.
Quickly add marshmallows on top of the cake. Bake for approximately 5 minutes (until marshmallows have a spread).
Gently squish marshmallows down with a spoon. Slowly pour frosting over marshmallows, being sure to cover as much as possible. Allow to cool for 15 minutes.
